title: Splish Splash Fun with Friends
description: Join Zuri (warm brown skin, afro puffs, yellow sundress), Kofi (light brown skin, natural curls, blue shirt) and Nala (medium brown skin, braided hair, pink dress) as they have fun at bath time!
characters: Zuri has warm brown skin, afro puffs and wears a yellow sundress. Kofi has light brown skin, natural curls and wears a blue shirt. Nala has medium brown skin, braided hair and wears a pink dress.

lines: We're washing our hands with soap so bright
verses.scene: The three friends stand at the kitchen sink, holding rubber ducks and soap

lines: Now we rinse off, what fun to play
verses.scene: Zuri blows a big bubble, Kofi pops it with his finger, Nala giggles

lines: We're splashing in the water's edge
Rubber ducks float, let's join the pledge
verses.scene: The three friends stand at the tub's edge, playing with rubber ducks and splashing their hands

lines: Clean and sparkly, we feel so free
Yes yes, bath time fun for you and me!
verses.scene: Zuri, Kofi and Nala high-five each other, smiling at the camera
